reports.title: COHERENT CORP. REPORTS FIRST QUARTER FISCAL 2027 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Business Outlook – Second Quarter Fiscal 2027(1)
section: • | Revenue for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 is expected to be between $2.55 billion and $2.75 billion.
• | Gross margin percentage for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 is expected to be between 40% and 42% on a non-GAAP basis.
• | Total operating expenses for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 are expected to be between $430 million and $450 million on a non-GAAP basis.
• | Tax rate for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 is expected to be between 18% and 20% on a non-GAAP basis.
• | EPS for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 is expected to be between $2.28 and $2.48 on a non-GAAP basis.

desk.headline: Revenue up 50% to $2.37bn, beat; Q2 outlook of $2.55–2.75bn above estimates
results: Revenue rose 50% to $2.37bn (56% excluding businesses sold); adjusted EPS jumped 80% to $2.09.
Datacenter & Communications sales grew 79% to $1.95bn and are now 82% of the total; Industrial fell 15% to $419m.
Non-GAAP gross margin improved to 40.6% and operating margin to 23.2%, helped by pricing and cost cuts.
Heavy investment: capex of $776m and inventory build left operating cash flow at -$93m; $773m was drawn on credit lines.

guidance.summary: For the December quarter Coherent expects revenue of $2.55–2.75bn and adjusted EPS of $2.28–2.48. It sees fiscal 2027 pro forma growth above 60% and set a new target of a quarter above 45% gross margin before end-2028.

points: Management tied growth to AI data centres moving from copper to optical links.
A new PhotonLink deal is valued at about $20bn over five years, with revenue starting to ramp in early 2028.
In-house indium phosphide laser capacity doubled a quarter early and should more than double again by end-2027.
Industrial is expected to return to growth in Q2 on stronger chip-equipment orders.
Targets: a first $3bn revenue quarter by end of fiscal 2027 and a first $4bn quarter in fiscal 2028.
call.source: Investor presentation (Exhibit 99.2) and executive comments in the press release; Futurum Research, 6 Nov 2026

watch: Cash flow as capex and inventory stay high to add capacity.
PhotonLink revenue passing $100m in the March 2027 quarter.
